name: flashdrop
description: Live-shopping flash-sale platform: Redis admits, Postgres decides, Kafka carries the news, timers clean up.

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up --detach --wait postgres redis kafka && docker compose run --rm kafka-init
scripts.stack:up: docker buildx bake --file docker-bake.hcl --load && docker compose --profile app up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 300
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --profile app rm --stop --force migrate api-1 api-2 web caddy
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --profile app logs --follow --tail=100 migrate api-1 api-2 web caddy
